Class CarPark

java.lang.Object
CarPark
public class CarPark extends Object
The car park. It keeps the list of parking slots and carries out all business rules: unique slot IDs, parking only in free slots of the right type, a car in only one slot, and no deleting of occupied slots. It contains no user-interface code; problems are reported by throwing exceptions whose messages can be shown to the user.
Version:
1.0

    • deleteSlot

      public void deleteSlot(String slotId)
      Deletes an unoccupied slot.
      Parameters:
      slotId - the ID of the slot to delete
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the slot does not exist
      IllegalStateException - if a car is parked in the slot

    • parkCar

      public void parkCar(String slotId, Car car)
      Parks a car in a slot. The slot must exist, be empty and be of the right type, and the car must not already be parked somewhere else.
      Parameters:
      slotId - the slot to use
      car - the car to park
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the car is null or the slot does not exist
      IllegalStateException - if a rule is broken (occupied slot, wrong type, car already parked)

    • removeCar

      public Car removeCar(String regoNumber)
      Removes a car from the car park.
      Parameters:
      regoNumber - the registration number of the car to remove
      Returns:
      the car that was removed (with its parking time still recorded)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no parked car has that registration number
